_comment: v1.1 Sentinel §1.3 — Performance baseline (v1.0.0 release values).
Each benchmark records: name, rom, frames_per_iter, iterations, and
the median total wall-clock time in milliseconds over 5 iterations,
measured on the same machine class (GitHub Actions windows-2022,
MSVC 14.44, x64, Release config, no ASan/UBSan).
The bench_tolerance_test binary loads this file and enforces
±2% relative deviation. The first time the test runs on a new
host it auto-creates a host-local baseline at
over this file in CI via env var FCEUX11_BENCH_BASELINE).
Reference values below are the documented v1.0.0 release numbers
from the smoke/24h test reports. They were captured on a
dedicated runner and are stable to within ±1% on identical
hardware. CI hosts will typically be 5-15% slower, which is why
the auto-local baseline is preferred there.
